text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
As expected of authentic Kyushu!
That rich tonkotsu ramen was delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...In that case, it makes me curious about
the authentic taste from Hokkaido and Yamagata..."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next stop: Hokkaido!
Miso ramen, shio ramen—
I'm gonna savor every bite!
And so, Epiphaneia traversed across Japan and seemed to have spent a thoroughly fulfilling day off!
